stories.headline: Spanish priest helps over 1,200 people find a spouse using WhatsApp
stories.summary: A Catholic clergyman in Spain is utilizing mobile messaging to connect men and women seeking faith-filled marriages. Through tailored surveys that emphasize spiritual commitment, Father Fernando Cuevas has guided more than twelve hundred unmarried believers toward their future spouses on WhatsApp. His approach demonstrates a practical way digital platforms are nurturing shared Christian callings today.
